gate_outcome_note: Direct execution held. The stage stayed inside its three declared files, needed no escalation, and produced no scope drift. The focused access integration suite is 24/24 on a freshly created disposable database (run id p11_access_tx_m1a), up from the 22 Slice A recorded, and pnpm verify:fast is green. The decisive evidence is that the case-insensitivity test passes: it can only pass if the pg error actually carries .constraint equal to auth_principals_owner_email_unique, which was the one thing the design could not establish by reading. One freeze-class defect - Biome formatting in this record - was found and repaired inside the stage before submission, which is the writing stage finishing its own work rather than a gate outcome.
material_selection_reason: The route comparison was opened and the external pool competed; it lost on a verification fact rather than on convenience. What decides this stage is a concurrency test observed running against the disposable Postgres - one 200 and N-1 typed refusals under a real unique-constraint race. That run needs real database credentials, which the durable external-worker authorization excludes as a payload class, so an external worker could author the test but never watch it fail and pass. Splitting a race test's look-judge-adjust loop across a packet boundary would iterate through the orchestrator anyway, at more cost than doing it. No other trigger applies: Volume was already spent by stage 1, which was delegated; Independence does not apply to producing a candidate; the stage needs exactly the write scope the coordinator holds; and the branch is the rollback boundary. Recorded explicitly because the inverse reasoning is a named anti-pattern: the coordinator did not perform this stage's target-file reading inline and is not citing accumulated context. Stage 1's discovery was delegated and its product is a durable record.
